title: Remark
body_md:
The formula (\ref{5.1}) represents the law of the asymptotic equality of the areas (measures) of complicated figures corresponding to the positive part and
the negative part, respectively, of the graph of the function
\begin{equation} \label{5.2}
\sum_{2\leq n\leq \xi}\frac{d(n)}{\sqrt{n}}\cos\{\varphi_1(t)\ln n\}Z^2\{\varphi_1(t)\}\tilde{Z}^2(t),\ t\in\mathring{G}_3(x)\cup\mathring{G}_4(x) ,
\end{equation}
where $x\in (0,\pi/2]$. This is one of the laws governing the \emph{chaotic} behaviour of the positive and negative values of the signal (\ref{5.2}).
This signal is created by the complicated modulation of the fundamental signal $Z(t)=e^{i\vartheta(t)}\zeta\left(\frac{1}{2}+it\right)$, (comp. (\ref{1.4}), (\ref{2.2})).
